'''Carney''' is the [[Captain]] of [[Bluewing]], a two-masted vessel.

He is a wide, sun-dark man with mustaches waxed to spikes.

He ensures [[Moiraine]] that Bluewing is the fastest vessel on the River [[Erinin]].
